meeting.title: Modal weekly implementation sync
meeting.summary: Weekly sync on the Modal onboarding. Dashboards for the inference-cost pilot are on track. Main topic was single sign-on: Dmitri will configure the Okta SAML app on Modal's side this week, and Theo will send over the SAML metadata file and ACS URL by Friday June 26th.
action_items: Dmitri to configure the Okta SAML app on Modal's side this week
Theo to send SAML metadata file and ACS URL by Friday June 26th
key_decisions: SSO enforcement will be enabled for the pilot group only, not the whole org, until go-live
meeting.notes: Dmitri already has admin access to the Modal Okta tenant, so no extra approvals are needed on their side.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Alright, thanks both for joining. Quick agenda: pilot dashboards, then SSO, then anything else.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Sounds good. Dashboards first — the inference-cost dashboard looks great, the team has been using it daily.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Love to hear it. Any numbers looking off?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Nothing so far. A couple of people asked for a filter by GPU type but that's a nice-to-have, not urgent.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Noted as a nice-to-have then. Okay, SSO. This is the big one blocking wider rollout.

transcript.speaker: Dmitri Volkov
transcript.text: Yeah, that's me. I looked at the Okta side yesterday and it's straightforward — standard SAML 2.0 app.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Exactly, we're a standard SP-initiated flow. You'll need our metadata to set up the app.

transcript.speaker: Dmitri Volkov
transcript.text: Right. I'll get the Okta SAML app configured on our side this week — it's already on my list for this sprint.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Perfect. And on my end, I'll send the SAML metadata file and our ACS URL by end of day Friday, June 26th, so you have everything you need.

transcript.speaker: Dmitri Volkov
transcript.text: Great, that works. One question — do we enforce SSO for everyone immediately?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: I'd rather not force the whole org through it before go-live. Can we scope enforcement to the pilot group?

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Yes, enforcement is per-group. Let's agree: pilot group only until go-live, then we flip it org-wide.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Anything else before we wrap? No? Okay — Dmitri on the Okta app, me on the metadata by Friday. Talk next week.
